# v1.1.0-dev.122: A maximized virtual window that stays put

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.121`.

## Maximizing a fully docked virtual window no longer shifts it

Maximizing a fully docked virtual window moved every docked window's
picture 11 pixels right and 11 pixels down. The window on the right ran
off the edge of the screen, the one on the left picked up a gap along its
edges, and the divider you could actually grab sat under the left window
while the gap you could see was off to its right. The pictures were being
placed from the corner of the window's outer frame, which Windows pushes
past the screen's edge when it maximizes a window. They're placed from
the corner of the visible area now, so every docked window lands exactly
on its pane, and the divider you see is the divider you grab.

## Panes reach the bottom of a maximized window

The drawn panes in a maximized virtual window stopped 2 pixels short of
the windows in them at the bottom. The size they were drawn from was read
a moment too early during the maximize and was never read again. They're
now drawn from the same measurements the docked windows are placed with,
so the two can't disagree.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
